title: Seeing Beyond Pixels: Radar Feature Generation from Images and Sparse Returns
abstract: arXiv:2611.28119v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Camera-radar fusion benefits from complementary visual and geometric information but often relies on complete radar representations, leading to substantial computing overhead. However, the extent to which visual information can compensate for limited radar measurements remains insufficiently explored. Therefore, we propose Vision-informed Radar Token Generation (VRTG), which exploits cross-modal information to generate task-relevant radar features from camera images and sparse radar measurements. Specifically, VRTG first leverages image-derived object cues to select a limited number of informative radar points. It then establishes calibrated one-to-one associations between visual objects and radar returns, using matched measurements to refine object ranges while retaining visual estimates for unmatched objects. translated_title: 超越像素的视觉感知：从图像与稀疏雷达回波生成雷达特征
translated_abstract: 相机-雷达融合得益于互补的视觉与几何信息，但通常依赖完整的雷达表征，从而带来巨大的计算开销。然而，视觉信息能在多大程度上弥补有限的雷达测量，仍缺乏充分探索。为此，我们提出了视觉引导的雷达令牌生成方法（VRTG），利用跨模态信息从相机图像和稀疏雷达测量中生成与任务相关的雷达特征。具体而言，VRTG 首先利用从图像中提取的目标线索筛选出数量有限且信息丰富的雷达点；随后建立视觉目标与雷达回波之间经过校准的一对一关联，利用匹配的测量来修正目标距离，同时对未匹配的目标保留视觉估计值；最后，将关联的目标特征与视觉上下文转化为与现有相机-雷达框架兼容的雷达令牌。
tldr: 提出VRTG方法，利用图像目标线索与稀疏雷达回波建立校准的一对一关联，从视觉信息生成与现有相机-雷达框架兼容的雷达特征令牌，从而在稀疏雷达测量下降低计算开销。
en_tdlr: Proposes VRTG, which generates task-relevant radar tokens compatible with existing camera-radar frameworks by leveraging image-derived object cues to associate with sparse radar returns, reducing computational overhead under limited radar measurements.
